description: BlueScreenView - read the crash dumps left by blue screens and show the bug check code plus the drivers on the stack
notes: The app auto-elevates: every launch raises a UAC prompt, because reading C:\Windows\Minidump needs administrator rights.
Settings go to BlueScreenView.cfg next to the exe, written when the window closes - pre-created as an empty file so scoop persists it as a file, not a directory junction.
A translation file (BlueScreenView.exe /savelangfile writes BlueScreenView_lng.ini) is deliberately not persisted: an empty placeholder would be loaded as an empty translation and blank out the UI.
Last release is 1.55 (January 2015) - it still reads modern minidumps, but do not expect further updates. checkver watches the PAD manifest anyway, since the download URLs carry no version.
